summary: Learn fairness testing, AI governance, and impact assessment with practical tools. Build accountable AI controls and reporting.
lede: AI ethics, bias and fairness practice helps professionals responsible for assessing or governing AI systems identify risks and document review decisions. The course covers bias sources and data quality, fairness metrics and testing, explainability, impact assessments, and human oversight, with practical work on a risk register, decision-review workflow, and governance reporting. Participants also examine vendor oversight and responsible AI roadmaps.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who assess, govern, or report on AI ethics, bias and fairness in live business settings.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: Working knowledge of AI or machine learning concepts, plus experience with data-driven decision making, risk, compliance, product, or analytics work. You should be comfortable reading model outputs, dashboards, and basic audit findings. Recommended preparation: Familiarity with fairness concepts, model evaluation metrics, and basic data privacy principles will help you move faster. No coding/programming is required to complete the course, although prior exposure to Python, SQL, or notebook-based analysis will help you engage more deeply with the toolkit demonstrations. Course level: Intermediate. Advanced governance concepts are taught at an operational application level, not production engineering depth.
